title: OpenUI real-browser integration verification
method: Live DSH web session driven over CDP; the model was asked to call visualize; results read from the accessibility tree and screenshots.

cases.name: Plugin load
cases.evidence: No "Failed to load plugins" banner. Console buffer empty (next_since=0, no entries).
cases.note: First run FAILED: bundle registered id @nagi-ovo/dsh-visualize while the host resolved @dsh-unified/visualize. Fixed by reading the id from package.json at build time.

cases.name: Both toolviews registered
cases.evidence: Two keyed tool.call.toolview registrations exist (visualize, intelligent_ui); the HTML card in this session rendered through the visualize key and a legacy intelligent_ui key is registered beside it.

cases.name: OpenUI card displays
cases.evidence: Card rendered from backend=openui: title "Browser Test", then Col/Text/Button content as real nodes (button "Test Button"). Screenshot openui-basic.png.
cases.note: It did NOT fall back to the generic tool-result text.

cases.name: HTML card displays (no regression)
cases.evidence: Second turn with backend=html produced Iframe "HTML Card" with visible content and the 在新窗口打开 control. Screenshot html-card.png.

cases.name: Streaming preview
cases.reason: The model emitted the whole program in one chunk; no partial argument stream was observable to assert against. The code path (openuiMetaFromArgs partial recovery) is unit-tested but not observed live.

cases.name: Text safety
cases.evidence: Fragment text renders as StaticText inside the frame accessibility tree; stored fragment contains <img and no raw

cases.name: Layout
cases.evidence: Round 1 screenshot showed "Test Button" centred in the card instead of left-aligned.
cases.rootCause: The card body and Col were flex columns without align-items, so a lone Button was centred on the cross axis.
cases.fix: align-items: stretch on the card body and Col; align-self: flex-start on Button. Two regression tests added.
cases.reverify: Client bundle rebuilt and reloaded; see MANIFEST note — the aligned render was NOT re-screenshotted with a fresh card after the fix.

cases.name: Light and dark theme
cases.reason: Only the light theme was exercised. The OpenUI card reads host CSS variables, but no dark-theme render was captured.

cases.name: Reload / replay
cases.evidence: After a full navigation to the same URL, the folds were re-expanded and the card content reappeared as nodes ("Browser Test", "OpenUI Browser Test", "Hello DSH", button "Test Button") with no new model call. Screenshot session-replay.png.

cases.name: Session switching
cases.reason: No second session was opened and compared; card-to-session binding was not exercised.

cases.name: Console clean
cases.evidence: bsk console returned {"tab_id":1517564808,"next_since":0,"truncated":false} with no entries after load and interaction.

defectsFound.summary: Client bundle registered the pre-fork package id, so the host could not activate the plugin.
defectsFound.fix: Read the id from package.json at build time.
defectsFound.lesson: The build succeeded and every unit test passed; only a real host load exposed it.

defectsFound.summary: OpenUI card centred a lone Button.
defectsFound.fix: align-items: stretch + Button align-self: flex-start; regression tests.

limitations: Slider is drawn disabled and Button has no action: actions need $state and the evaluator (stage 2/3). They render without error.
No evaluator: @function calls are not computed; only structure renders.
